business_overview.one_sentence: The group operates a displays and related services business and also holds substantial equity investments, especially the remaining listed Nantong Jianghai stake after the 2025 disposal.
business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is recognised when control of display products/services transfers to customers; some customers pay deposits when sales orders are issued.
business_notes: Contract liabilities are deposits received from customers, generally 10% to 100% of contract value.
After completion of the Nantong Jianghai disposal on 2025-01-13, the remaining 13.81% stake is measured as FVTPL financial assets.

non_recurring_items.item: Gain on disposal of an associate
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Gain from disposal of Nantong Jianghai associate stake, not recurring display operations profit.
non_recurring_items.source: 2024/25 annual report, consolidated profit or loss, p.44; note 25/26, p.102

non_recurring_items.item: Net loss on fair value changes of financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Mark-to-market movement mainly including remaining Nantong Jianghai listed equity and strategic investments.
non_recurring_items.source: 2024/25 annual report, profit or loss and FVTPL note, p.44 and p.102

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Associate contribution; not cash profit from controlled display operations.
non_recurring_items.source: 2024/25 annual report, consolidated profit or loss, p.44

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank balances and cash, including short-term bank deposits with original maturity of three months or less; group-level location by parent/subsidiary not disclosed.
funds_assets.source: 2024/25 annual report, statement of financial position and note 24, p.47 and p.101

funds_assets.business_substance: Listed bonds graded speculative credit risk, maturity extended to 2028-2029; not cash-equivalent.

operating_assets.business_substance: Raw materials, work in progress and finished goods for display operations.
Trade receivables, loan receivables, other receivables, deposits and prepayments; trade credit period 30-150 days.

operating_assets.source: 2024/25 annual report, statement of financial position, p.47

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - PRC listed equity securities
investment_assets.business_substance: Remaining 13.81% Nantong Jianghai listed equity stake after disposal; marketable but subject to equity-market, tax and block disposal constraints.

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - unlisted equity investments
investment_assets.business_substance: Strategic unlisted PRC GPU company investment, not held for trading.

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - unlisted limited partnership
investment_assets.business_substance: Unlisted PRC limited partnership with semiconductor/materials underlying investments; not held for trading.
Remaining associate Suzhou QingYue; operating associate, not treated as detachable cash.

other_assets.item: Right-of-use assets, investment properties, intangible assets and non-current prepayments
other_assets.source: 2024/25 annual report, statement of financial position, p.47

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Unsecured bank borrowings due within one year, variable rate 4.80% to 6.74%.
Operating lease liabilities for continuing operations; not mechanically deducted from detachable cash in owner-earnback calculation.

operating_liabilities.source: 2024/25 annual report, statement of financial position, p.47

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Deposits from customers when sales orders are issued.

investment_liabilities.item: Deferred tax liabilities related to fair value changes of financial assets at FVTPL
investment_liabilities.business_substance: Tax reserve linked to fair value change of FVTPL assets; deducted as tax/friction reserve in detachable net cash.

other_liabilities.source: 2024/25 annual report, statement of financial position, p.47

years.source: 2022/23 annual report, p.40-47 and segment note
2023/24 annual report, p.44-51 and segment note
2024/25 annual report, p.44-53 and segment note

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year owner net profit is dominated by associate disposal/investment items. Controlled display segment profit fell from HK$88.079m to HK$54.956m and then to a HK$1.492m loss. 2025 operating cash flow was only HK$14.518m while capex was HK$156.392m, so sustainable distributable cash requires a large haircut.

evidence.source: company website annual report page and PDF title
evidence.note: input requested_period is 2024-12-31, but the annual report available and used is fiscal year ended 2025-03-31.

evidence.source: 2024/25 annual report, statement of financial position and note 24, p.47 and p.101

gaps: Annual report does not split cash by listed parent, Hong Kong subsidiaries, PRC subsidiaries or other operating subsidiaries.
No precise restricted-cash schedule was found; cash note describes bank balances and short-term deposits but not a parent-level distributable cash table.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; owner-earnback uses conservative capex and profit haircut instead of treating all capex as maintenance.
